title: Restore the monthly sales report load time to under 5 seconds

sections.In plain terms: The monthly sales report has become slow to open since a recent release. It used to load in about 2 seconds and should load in under 5 again.
sections.Context: Since last Tuesday's release the report loads slowly. Finance uses it all day during month-end close — café ✓.
sections.Acceptance Criteria:
1. The report loads in under 5 seconds on the reports page
2. The cause is named in the pull request
